body: Data centers do bring real benefits to local communities, U.S. competitiveness, and national security. They can provide communities with property tax revenue (even at reduced rates), anchor investment that can attract additional development, and generate jobs. Data centers in Loudoun County, Virginia, pay enough in property taxes to fund the county’s entire general operations budget.

. Twenty-three states require job creation commitments, ranging from 5-100 new positions. Nine states incorporate geographic factors, offering lower investment thresholds for facilities built in opportunity zones or distressed communities.
